_comment: Where verify.yml runs its Windows sections (tools/ci/runner-router.cjs). 2026-10-01: required Windows CI moves to WarpBuild Azure BYOC (popcre-ci-use1, win-2022) to cut cost; the blacksmith_windows key name is kept for test compatibility but the value is the WarpBuild label. Idle qualified self-hosted Windows hosts (EDGE-RUNN-ENVY and any other host carrying ai-devops-windows-qualified) remain extra capacity. A section goes to a qualified host only when one is online and idle at routing time; otherwise it runs on WarpBuild. GitHub-hosted runners are never a routing target. Manual Blacksmith fallback lives in windows-offline-blacksmith.yml.
